scene_analysis.scene_overview: A city street view of a large building with multiple stories and balconies, surrounded by other buildings and trees. The street has a white line down the middle and cars parked along the sides. People are walking on the sidewalk and there are various businesses along the street including a clothing store and a restaurant. The sky is overcast.
scene_analysis.buildings: The main building is cream colored with a beige facade and has many windows and balconies. It is at least five stories tall and has a flat roof. There are two smaller buildings on either side of it, one with a yellow facade and the other with a brown facade. The street is paved with asphalt and has a white line running down the middle.
scene_analysis.materials: The main building has a cream-colored facade with stone quoins at the corners. The second story has a balcony with a railing. The third story has a large window with a rounded top. The fourth and fifth stories have rectangular windows with black frames. The ground floor has a storefront with a sign reading'sehor' and a display window with mannequins dressed in clothes.
scene_analysis.street_furniture: There are several benches and trash cans along the sidewalk. There is also a bike rack near the corner of the street.
scene_analysis.vegetation: There are several trees and bushes along the sidewalk. They are well-maintained and add some greenery to the urban landscape.
scene_analysis.signage: There are several signs along the street, including a blue sign with white lettering and a black sign with white lettering. There is also a small sign on the side of the street that reads 'Café'.
scene_analysis.as_resident: A local resident might notice the lack of outdoor seating and the presence of trash cans along the sidewalk.
scene_analysis.as_commuter: A commuter might notice the convenience of the location and the proximity to public transportation.
scene_analysis.as_tourist: A tourist might notice the historic charm of the area and the unique character of the buildings.
scene_analysis.as_student: A student might notice the academic atmosphere of the area.
